description: A scripted control for a base whose image is built with a parameter: the toolchain version is a build argument that the image's own step writes to /etc/toolchain. It stands in for a real toolchain axis (a Go auditor on Go 1.20 and 1.23), for which no fixture exists.

TOOLCHAIN.about: the toolchain version the image is built with

toolchain-built.description: the image was built with the toolchain this configuration names
